title: Integration tests for init and add commands
description: Write and run integration tests covering all acceptance criteria from the spec: idempotent init, add UUID output, dual-table rows, auto-init, --db and AGENT_MEMORY_DB overrides, embedding shape and L2 norm, model download with progress stderr, SHA256 failure path, and transaction rollback on failure.
acceptance_criteria: All spec acceptance criteria are covered by at least one test
Tests pass end-to-end against the real memory.py (not mocked)
SHA256 failure path test confirms exit code 1 and partial file cleanup
Transaction rollback test confirms DB is unchanged after simulated insert failure
